_comment: BUILD_SPEC §10.1. Synthetic items, every title prefixed [TEST] so they can never be mistaken for production output. `expect` is the assertion the suite enforces.

items.title: [TEST] KKR agrees to buy a theme-park operator for $4bn
items.summary: KKR has agreed to acquire a regional theme-park operator in an all-cash transaction valuing the business at about $4 billion. The buyout is expected to close next year.

expect.why: PE buyout by a tracked GP. The single most important test in the suite.

items.title: [TEST] Apollo and KKR to back Atlantic Aviation at about $10bn valuation
items.summary: Apollo Global Management and KKR have agreed to invest in Atlantic Aviation, the fixed-base operator network, in a transaction valuing the aviation services business at roughly $10 billion.

expect.why: Aviation infrastructure equity, not aircraft-leasing credit.

items.title: [TEST] Apollo 11 anniversary exhibition opens at the space museum
items.summary: A new exhibition marking the Apollo 11 lunar landing opens this weekend, featuring NASA artefacts and a restored command module.

items.title: [TEST] Guggenheim Museum unveils new wing in Bilbao
items.summary: The Guggenheim Museum has unveiled a new exhibition wing, its largest expansion in a decade.

items.title: [TEST] Bain & Company report says consulting demand rebounds
items.summary: A new report from Bain & Company finds that demand for strategy consulting rebounded in the first half, led by technology clients.

items.title: [TEST] PAG dealership group posts record quarter
items.summary: Penske Automotive Group, which trades under the ticker PAG, reported record quarterly revenue on strong used-vehicle sales.

expect.why: Penske Automotive Group, not PAG the credit manager.

items.title: [TEST] Basepoint Business Centres opens new workspace in Reading
items.summary: Basepoint Business Centres has opened a serviced office space in Reading, adding 40 units of flexible workspace.

expect.why: Wrong Basepoint: the UK serviced-office operator.

items.title: [TEST] HSBC reports group pre-tax profit of $8.2bn
items.summary: HSBC Holdings reported group pre-tax profit of $8.2 billion, helped by a wider net interest margin in its retail banking division.

expect.why: HSBC the bank, not HSBC Asset Management.

items.title: [TEST] Blue Owl acquires net-lease retail portfolio for $1.1bn
items.summary: Blue Owl Capital has agreed to acquire a portfolio of net-lease retail properties for about $1.1 billion through its real estate equity strategy.

expect.why: Real-estate equity by a tracked GP; explicitly out of scope in Blue Owl's credit_scope.

items.title: [TEST] New private credit interval fund launches for retail investors
items.summary: A new interval fund offering retail investors access to private credit has launched with a $500 minimum investment and quarterly liquidity windows.

expect.why: Retail product marketing with no portfolio consequence. Tier 3.

items.title: [TEST] Podcast: a veteran investor on the future of private credit
items.summary: In this week's episode, a veteran credit investor discusses where he sees the private credit market heading over the next decade and what younger analysts should study.

expect.why: Interview with no new fact. Tier 3.

items.title: [TEST] Blue Owl Technology Finance reports Q2 results, NAV $17.20, non-accruals 0.4%
items.summary: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp reported net asset value of $17.20 per share for the second quarter, down from $17.44. Non-accruals rose to 0.4% of the portfolio at fair value. The BDC declared a quarterly dividend of $0.35 a share.

expect.why: Direct BDC earnings event at a tracked holding. Tier 1.

items.title: [TEST] Bayview Asset Management acquires $10bn mortgage servicing portfolio
items.summary: Bayview Asset Management has agreed to acquire mortgage servicing rights on a portfolio of about $10 billion in unpaid principal balance, expanding its Lakeview servicing platform.

expect.why: Direct transaction at a tracked GP in a tracked sub-sector. Tier 1.

items.title: [TEST] PAG closes $2bn Asia private credit fund
items.summary: PAG has held a final close for its latest Asia private credit fund at $2 billion, above its original target. The fund will lend to mid-market borrowers across the region.

expect.why: Tracked GP, tracked sub-sector. Asia is allowed because PAG is a holding, not because Asia is a target region.

items.title: [TEST] CLO AAA spreads tighten to 120bp as issuance sets monthly record
items.summary: Spreads on AAA rated CLO liabilities tightened to 120 basis points this week as monthly issuance set a record, with managers rushing to price deals before quarter end.

expect.why: Sub-sector market data with no tracked GP named. Tier 2.

items.title: [TEST] European direct lending deal count falls in Q3
items.summary: The number of European direct lending transactions fell 12% in the third quarter, according to new data, as borrowers returned to the syndicated loan market for cheaper financing.

items.title: [TEST] Software borrowers face refinancing squeeze as AI reshapes demand
items.summary: Lenders are reassessing recurring-revenue loans to enterprise software companies as AI-driven competition slows renewal rates. Several mid-market software borrowers face 2027 maturities at materially wider spreads.

expect.why: The sub-sector thesis the portfolio is directly exposed to. Tier 2.

items.title: [TEST] Bain Capital launches JB Aircraft Finance
items.summary: Bain Capital has launched JB Aircraft Finance, a new platform that will provide debt financing secured on commercial aircraft, seeded with $1.5 billion of commitments.

expect.why: Tracked GP entering a tracked sub-sector.

items.title: [TEST] Mid-market software firm Vantify misses interest payment
items.summary: Vantify, a mid-market enterprise software vendor, missed a scheduled interest payment this week, according to people familiar with the matter.
items.body: Vantify, a mid-market enterprise software vendor, missed a scheduled interest payment on its term loan this week, according to people familiar with the matter. The $340 million unitranche facility was led by Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp, which holds roughly 40% of the loan, with the balance syndicated to two other private credit managers. Lenders have retained advisers ahead of a possible restructuring. The company had been marked at 94 cents on the dollar at the most recent quarter end.

expect.why: Agent 2 sees headline + snippet only and should discard. Agent 3, with the body, must rescue it: the lead lender is a tracked BDC. This is the test that proves Agent 3 earns its cost.
